description: This file defines the ProjectController class, which manages the project-related views and permissions in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends an abstract controller and utilizes traits for permission management and project service logic. The preRender method prepares the component for rendering, including fetching unselectable project IDs and setting permissions.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller class managing project views and permissions within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by setting up the project list component and permissions.
